categories.main_business_segments: Kimco Realty Corporation is North America's largest publicly traded owner and operator of open-air, grocery-anchored shopping centers and a growing portfolio of mixed-use assets. As of December 31, 2023, the company had interests in 523 shopping center properties aggregating 89.7 million square feet of gross leasable area (GLA) located in 28 states, plus 21 other property interests totaling 5.5 million square feet of GLA. The company's properties are primarily anchored by grocery stores, home improvement centers, off-price retailers, discounters, and service-oriented tenants.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs a self-administered REIT structure with in-house expertise in real estate acquisition, development, redevelopment, and property management. Core operational methods include active portfolio management, property redevelopment and renovation programs, tenant leasing and management, and mixed-use development capabilities. The company utilizes institutional joint venture programs where it earns management fees, acquisition fees, disposition fees, and promoted interests based on performance metrics.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company's primary customers are retail tenants including major national and regional companies such as TJX Companies, The Home Depot, Albertsons Companies, Ross Stores, Amazon/Whole Foods Market, Burlington Stores, PetSmart, Ahold Delhaize, Kroger, and Walmart. The company serves customers in 28 states with significant concentration in top 10 metropolitan markets including New York, Baltimore-Washington D.C., Los Angeles-Orange County-San Diego, Miami-Ft. Lauderdale, Houston, San Francisco-Sacramento-San Jose, Phoenix, Philadelphia, Orlando, and Raleigh-Durham.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in the United States with a consolidated operating portfolio located entirely in the U.S., inclusive of Puerto Rico. As of December 31, 2023, the company derived 86% of its proportionate share of annualized base rental revenues from its top major metro markets. The portfolio is geographically diversified across 28 states with concentration in first-ring suburbs of major metropolitan areas, predominantly on the east and west coasts and in the sun belt region.
categories.supply_chain_position: Kimco Realty operates as a real estate owner and operator in the downstream/retail segment of the supply chain. The company owns and operates shopping center properties that serve as retail destinations for end consumers. The company does not manufacture products but rather provides leased retail space to tenants who sell goods and services directly to consumers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategic priorities include: (1) increasing value of existing portfolio through redevelopment and mixed-use development; (2) focusing on high-quality locations with strong demographics and population growth; (3) obtaining multi-family residential entitlements (9,945 units entitled, 3,157 constructed as of December 31, 2023); (4) emphasizing live/work/play environments and Signature Series properties; (5) maintaining strong balance sheet with investment-grade debt ratings (BBB+/Baa1); and (6) pursuing ESG initiatives including 30% Scope 1 and 2 GHG emissions reduction by 2030 and net zero by 2050.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through base rental income from long-term leases with tenants, supplemented by operating expense reimbursements (real estate taxes, insurance, utilities, common area maintenance), percentage rents, and management and other fee income. Minimum base rental revenues, operating expense reimbursements, and percentage rents accounted for 98% of total revenues from rental properties in 2023. The company also earns management fees, acquisition fees, disposition fees, and promoted interests from institutional joint venture programs.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Kimco Realty is positioned as North America's largest publicly traded owner and operator of open-air, grocery-anchored shopping centers. The company competes with numerous regional and local commercial developers, real estate companies, financial institutions, and other investors for property acquisitions and tenant leasing. Competition exists from other shopping centers, e-commerce platforms, outlet malls, discount shopping clubs, and alternative retail formats. The company's competitive advantages include its scale, established relationships with major retailers, geographic diversification, and deep industry expertise.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of December 31, 2023, the company had a market capitalization of approximately $12.0 billion (based on June 30, 2023 closing price). For the year ended December 31, 2023, net income available to common shareholders was $629.3 million ($1.02 per diluted share), compared to $100.8 million ($0.16 per diluted share) in 2022. FFO was $970.0 million ($1.57 per diluted share) in 2023 versus $976.4 million ($1.58 per diluted share) in 2022. Same property NOI increased 2.4% year-over-year. The company has grown substantially since its IPO in 1991, raising over $17.9 billion through public capital markets.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Kimco Realty's value proposition centers on providing essential, necessity-based retail destinations in high-quality, demographically strong locations with significant barriers to entry. The company differentiates through: (1) focus on grocery-anchored properties offering everyday essentials; (2) geographic concentration in first-ring suburbs of major metropolitan areas with strong population growth; (3) active redevelopment and mixed-use development capabilities creating live/work/play environments; (4) diversified tenant base resistant to e-commerce disruption; (5) strong balance sheet and investment-grade ratings; (6) experienced management team with deep industry relationships; and (7) commitment to ESG and sustainability initiatives.
categories.additional_context: In January 2024, the company completed the RPT Merger, acquiring 56 open-air shopping centers (43 wholly owned, 13 through joint venture) comprising 13.3 million square feet of GLA. The company operates as a REIT, required to distribute at least 90% of REIT taxable income annually. The company paid dividends of $1.02 per share in 2023. The company maintains a weighted average debt maturity of 8.7 years and consolidated debt at 3.68% weighted average interest rate as of December 31, 2023.
